messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.1.9

1.1.9. Protection against corruption The machinery or related product shall be designed and constructed so that the connection to it of another device, via any feature of the connected device itself or via any remote device that communicates with the machinery or related product does not lead to a hazardous situation. A hardware component transmitting signal or data, relevant for connection or access to software that is critical for the compliance of the machinery or related product with the relevant essential health and safety requirements shall be designed so that it is adequately protected against accidental or intentional corruption. The machinery or related product shall collect evidence of a legitimate or illegitimate intervention in that hardware component, when relevant for connection or access to software that is critical for the compliance of the machinery or related product. Software and data that are critical for the compliance of the machinery or related product with the relevant essential health and safety requirements shall be identified as such and shall be adequately protected against accidental or intentional corruption. The machinery or related product shall identify the software installed on it that is necessary for it to operate safely, and shall be able to provide that information at all times in an easily accessible form. The machinery or related product shall collect evidence of a legitimate or illegitimate intervention in the software or a modification of the software installed on the machinery or related product or its configuration.

response.text:
Machinery or related product | shall be designed so that connecting another device does not lead to a hazardous situation | connection via any feature of the connected device or via any remote device | "does not lead to a hazardous situation"
Hardware component transmitting signal or data | shall be designed to be adequately protected against accidental or intentional corruption | relevant for connection or access to software critical for compliance | "shall be designed so that it is adequately protected against accidental or intentional corruption"
Machinery or related product | shall collect evidence of legitimate or illegitimate intervention in the hardware component | relevant for connection or access to software critical for compliance | "shall collect evidence of a legitimate or illegitimate intervention in that hardware component"
Software and data critical for compliance | shall be identified as such | | "shall be identified as such"
Software and data critical for compliance | shall be adequately protected against accidental or intentional corruption | | "shall be adequately protected against accidental or intentional corruption"
Machinery or related product | shall identify the installed software necessary for safe operation | | "shall identify the software installed on it that is necessary for it to operate safely"
Machinery or related product | shall be able to provide safety-necessary software information at all times in an easily accessible form | | "shall be able to provide that information at all times in an easily accessible form"
Machinery or related product | shall collect evidence of legitimate or illegitimate intervention in, or modification of, installed software or its configuration | | "shall collect evidence of a legitimate or illegitimate intervention in the software or a modification of the software installed on the machinery or related product or its configuration"
